children: Elon Musk has pushed back on speculation that Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Co.
could own and operate the Terafab chipmaking project.

“No, we will build and run the fab. Let there be ZERO doubt about that. Maybe TSMC subleases part of the Terafab if they want, but nothing more than that,” Musk said on X Wednesday, responding to a speculation that the “likeliest deal” would have TSMC owning and running the fab, with SpaceX
investing in the facility or committing to purchase chip.

The comments come days after Musk confirmed that he was in discussions with TSMC about a potential collaboration around Terafab. That confirmation followed a report that TSMC is looking at running new chip factories in Texas.
